why: Second fix round for slice F of the exam-to-lint plan (0591, docs/plan/quests/exam-to-lint-PLAN.md), allowed by the lead under 0564 after the review's second send-back (field/runs/2026-11-16-591-f-review2.json), on fabrikalfa/exam-to-lint-f from e6432cb. The review found that fabrika/one-page-runtime (oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.ts) read a string only as the key inside a computed member, so `const k = "runPromise"; Effect[k](page);` and `Reflect.get(Effect, "runFork")(page);` passed, while the deleted next/apps/fabrika/src/build.test.ts text check refused both. The fix: the MemberExpression visitor is replaced by a Literal visitor and a TemplateLiteral visitor, so every string literal and every template with no expressions, wherever it stands, is read as the name it spells. A run* name is reported as a run the page does not own, and "runMain" is a second page runtime; this also covers the member key. Only a "runMain" that names an import specifier is skipped there, since imports are counted at Program:exit. The rule's top comment and oxlint-plugins/README.md say so. M7's law (oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.test.ts) gains two generated planted entries: a run's name held in a variable then read as a key, and a run's name passed to Reflect.get. Both draw the name from runPromise, runFork, runSync and runMain (runMain must report a second runtime, the others a foreign run) in double quotes, single quotes or a template, and the property's coverage check requires each name and each quote to be drawn. The first send-back's three cases and the four string-key spellings stay.
